name: The Throbbing Urge
source:
Join the timid Zash, who in light of a recent breakthrough in his career, plans to move from the suffocating clutches of the inner city into the quaint countryside with his boyfriend. His circle of friends and acquaintances don't plan on letiing him leave that easily, however...

[From [url=https://spoonky.itch.io/the-throbbing-urge]Itch.io[/url]]
